{{Quote|Each one carries an army large enough to threaten an entire planet.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Core ships''', also called '''''Lucrehulk''-class modular control core''' or '''LH-1740''', were modified [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class]] modular control cores that were used as an autonomous [[Transport/Legends|transport]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and later the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as well as the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="CSS" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Coreship_front_landed.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A core ship in its landing-configuration, shown to scale with a [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transport]].]]

While fully capable spacecraft in their own right, the core ships were also able to reattach themselves to the outer ring [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] and thus could resume their role as command cores.<ref name="CSS" />
Thanks to their modular design, the spherical vessels could also be attached to a number of other Federation ship-designs, like cruisers, destroyers, tankers and container vessels.<ref name="CSS" />

===Dimensions===
The hierarchical arrangement of living quarters on a core ship resembled that of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] hives. The command bridges, executive suites and treasuries were located in the core ship's upper pole and towers. Lower levels were for junior managers, publicists and droid storage, and on at least some variants, much of the hull above the ship's equator served as a single vast hangar bay and flight deck.<ref name="CSS" />

The lowest levels were given over to engineering areas and conference rooms, areas habitually shunned by high-ranking [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] officials, who preferred to use droids to perform the demeaning and difficult responsibilities of dealing with outsiders or complex equipment.<ref name="CSS" />

===Propulsion systems===
Core ships were designed to be capable of planetary landing, and equipped with massive repulsorlift suspensor units installed on their ventral section. In addition to these repulsorlift units, a ventral ion-thruster allowed for rapid take-off and escape from orbit. The core ship was also equipped with numerous landing legs, though the landing gear required repulsorlift assistance to support the hull in launch posture for any length of time.<ref name="CSS" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
The basic type of core ship was a transport equipped only with point-defense laser cannons, designed to carry supplies around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It had a sensor array at the top of its command tower that was similar in style to the [[sensor globe]]s on the later [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] models.<ref name="CSS" />

==History==
{{Quote|Attack those Federation starships, quickly!|Obi-Wan Kenobi during the Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="AATC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
<div style="float:right">[[File:Lucrehulk-class_Core_Ships.jpg|thumb|200px|Core Ships on the surface of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].]]</div>

The core module design was at least a century old by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and had undergone few changes throughout that time.
However, after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ordered the Trade Federation to disband its military forces. The crafty Trade Federation pretended to comply with this command by apparently disassembling most of its battleships, only to transform their centrispheres into ''Lucrehulk''-class core ships.<ref name="CSS" />

[[File:SPHAT-concentratedfire.png|thumb|left|220px|[[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHAs]] concentrate fire on a fleeing Core Ship.]]
During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], core ships successfully withdrew legions of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] from the planet's foundries in the face of the Republic assault, and during the Clone Wars, they transported military equipment and troops to many worlds.<ref name="CSS" /> During the battle, some core ships were brought down by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHA-T]] walkers.

Towards the end of the Battle of Geonosis, a [[Delta Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] was able to infiltrate a disabled core ship and retrieve its launch codes. This allowed the Republic to prevent any more [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] ships from leaving the planet.

During the Clone Wars, core ships underwent upgrades and modifications which led to a variety of internal and external configurations.<ref name="SBP4" /> Some of these were combat-capable variants, [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] equipped with heavy weapons and [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] swarms that could match the Republic's medium capital ships.<ref name="SWR:TDOR" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Separatist force deployed to secure [[Spaarti Creations]] on [[Cartao/Legends|Cartao]] consisted of a core ship equipped with three [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and around five thousand battle droids.<ref name="HOC">{{InsiderCite|issue1=68|issue2=70|Hero of Cartao}}</ref>

Later on in the Clone Wars, a ship of this type, the ''[[Gahenna]]'', was involved in an orbital duel above [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] and subsequently crashed on the planet,<ref name="SWR68" /> while two more participated in the [[Battle of Rendili]], where they proved an equal match for two [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]]. When a third ''Acclamator'' and five [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class cruisers]] of the [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet]] had their firepower added to the battle, the two were destroyed.<ref name="SWR:TDOR" />

[[File:Trade_Federation_Core_Ship.jpg|thumb|right|A cutaway view of a ''Lucrehulk''-class Core ship docked in a launch shaft on Geonosis]]
At least one core ship, the ''[[Unlimited Projection]]'', was modified for long-term planetary deployment as a semi-permanent surface base on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] as the headquarters of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Another core ship was left derelict on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during the [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

Following the end of the Clone Wars, the few remaining ''Lucrehulk'' battleships and core ships were sold to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and to [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|wealthy merchants]].<ref name="TNEGTVAV" />
